description: This file defines the class Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Captcha, which manages the captcha extension within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling captcha extensions, as well as handling related configurations and permissions.

classes.name: Captcha
classes.description: Controller class for managing captcha extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, installing, and uninstalling captcha extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of captcha extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML snippet containing the list of available captcha extensions, their settings, and management links.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing a new captcha extension based on request parameters.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstalling an existing captcha extension based on request parameters.
